description: This DIW Berlin deposit publishes a German application of emobpy with synthetic profiles for 200 battery-electric vehicles. Each vehicle has mobility, driving electricity consumption, grid-connection availability and grid electricity-demand series over a one-year simulation horizon. Zenodo supplies three ZIP packages containing the input material, original 15-minute series and hourly aggregates. The current resolved record is 4514928 under concept 3931663 and explicitly states CC BY 4.0 with free access. These fixed outputs can drive charging-network capacity studies or compare electric-vehicle flexibility assumptions in power-system simulations, complementing the general generator model-emobpy. A caveat is that the profiles are generated scenarios, not observations from 200 tracked vehicles. Mobility statistics, vehicle assumptions and the charging strategy determine their representativeness. An hourly aggregate also loses within-hour connection and demand changes. The deposit's own metadata was inspected, but no profile package was downloaded and no energy totals or charging constraints were tested.
